verdict_reason: The new pagination, chosen-address and page-field tests are sound, but the template's client paging-selection hook is untested, one title over-claims and an empty '//' comment steers formatting.

todos.issue: A bare trailing '//' after renderPicker(...) on line 248 is an empty comment used only to steer Prettier's line break; it says nothing and the reader has to work out why it is there.
todos.fix: Must: the test has no empty comment; its lines are whatever Prettier produces. One way: assign the document first (const document = documentOf(renderPicker(pickerShowing({ selected: row })))) then const form = document.querySelector('form'), matching the other tests, and drop the '//'.

todos.issue: Title 'Should carry the page being shown in the form, so a search and a save know it' claims that a search and a save learn the page, but the test only asserts the hidden input[name=page] value is '2'; the 'so a search and a save know it' clause is rationale about callers the assertions do not prove.
todos.fix: Must: the title states only what the assertions prove. One way: 'Should hold the page being shown in a hidden page field of the form', leaving the search/save behaviour to the controller tests that prove it.

todos.issue: The PR adds data-module="app-picker-paging-selection" to the picker form (_address-picker.njk:63) so a radio ticked but not yet saved is carried onto the paging links (AC: 'the chosen address is still chosen' on another page). No test proves the template wires it: picker-paging-selection.test.js builds its own form markup, and the new ins-tests E2E (addresses-picker.spec.ts) only pages after a saved choice. Deleting the attribute from the template leaves every test green.
todos.fix: Must: removing the data-module attribute from the addressPicker form turns a test red. One way: in this file's addressPicker describe, assert documentOf(renderPicker(pickerShowing())).querySelector('form').dataset.module equals PickerPagingSelection.moduleName (import it), or add an E2E step that ticks an address on page 1, follows the page 2 link and asserts it is still chosen on return.
